# Collapsible

Opens and closes content over 200ms by animating a grid row from 0fr to 1fr, so nothing is measured in JavaScript. It clips only while moving: once open, focus rings and tooltips inside can spill out.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/collapsible)

## Usage

```tsx
<Collapsible open={!sameAsShipping}>
  <AddressForm … />
</Collapsible>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the content is shown. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Stays mounted while closed, hidden from sight, keyboard and screen readers. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Collapsible.module.css`
- `Collapsible.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
